question: Which document and measurement contracts determine pages, and which layout authority can be removed or reused?
method: best-api-review/history-v2; first-principles hard-cut comparison; live-source diagnostics and one independent same-model historical/proof reviewer
trigger: User accepted the recommended $best-api-review audit pagination after asking for the ledger item following history. Scope is assessment and local review recording.
requirements: Assess all seven pagination ledger units and materially different headless, editable, custom-unit and facade consumers; keep other Plate features separate.
Keep canonical content, history and collaboration with the editor; visual pages must not split semantic document nodes.
Preserve one native editable DOM and exact mounted-view selection, composition, permission and retirement ownership, including named roots.
Keep complete DOM as the default, explicit pagination-owned omission and direct page-canvas coordinates, reusing shared DOM coverage.
Make measurement precision, break semantics and headless/export authority truthful; do not retain public machinery without a current independent job.
evidenceReuse: First dedicated pagination review. Rechecked current source against May architecture, unfinished exactness, June failed performance experiments, August entrypoint rename, September selection setup and large-document adoption. Reuses semantic/no-AST-split, custom-unit and explicit-omission laws, not historical timings or passes. Current source contradicts the historical authoritative-snapshot recommendation. Independent worker reviewed history and current proof assertions; lead verified its decision-critical observations.
summary: Pursue view-owned read-only live pagination: cut the derived layout reader's false page-break persistence/authority protocol, challenge the mandatory external live controller and copied projection assembly, and make unit fragmentation truthful. A source probe accepts writer breaks for 11 pages while independently computing 22, demonstrates refresh-only state commits and inert page/avoid unit split behavior. The current paged view keeps its canvas and explicit omission; runtime replacement remains provisional pending Task design and matched native/scale proof.
alternatives: Keep/configure: preserve page settings, custom measurement and provider units, but configuration cannot make read-mode breaks determine pages or eliminate copied projection/invalidation assembly.

Change API: explore direct page/measurement inputs on the paged view, private lifecycle, explicit snapshot consumption and one truthful text/unit fragmentation contract. Proposed syntax is not implemented or runtime-accepted.
Add primitive: reject a new pagination session, state plugin, provider stack or authority token without an independent current job; reuse editor state, commits and DOM coverage.

Delete/merge/inline: delete pageBreaks read/write modes, snapshot/status/codec authority and lifecycle persistence; challenge the live PageLayout handle as required render assembly, public refresh timing/metrics, overlapping boxes and inert split values.

Move ownership: neutral measurement, live projection and native-flow integration belong to pagination/mounted view; feature schemas, table/media policy and page styling remain Plate/app owned. Standalone headless measurement must earn only the lifetime it needs.

Replace architecture: semantic page nodes or a second editor/history authority conflict with visual pagination. CSS-only and DOM-measured models remain legitimate comparators; historical scale claims do not disqualify them. Deleting the entire feature loses real custom-measurement, preview and editable-page jobs.
proofLimits: 7 expected/7 assessed/0 excluded/0 unresolved dispositions. Existing package partition: 58 passed, 213 assertions, four files. Disposable estimated-engine probe: one passed, 11 assertions, eight selected source hashes matching before/after. This reproduces current gaps, not candidate behavior. No product source or existing tests changed, no browser/device/candidate runtime/scale/export/collaboration/release proof ran. All 44 existing browser cases explicitly require Chromium; drag autoscroll also needs an environment flag. Visible-text timing is not settled page-layout timing. One independent same-model source reviewer, no cross-model panel; Autoreview not run under next branch policy. Runtime direction remains provisional; adoption remains not-assessed and proof partial.
